**brief:** `PIXEL_BRIEF_BM25=auto` gives a plain-language prompt leads ranked by BM25 over each file's path and symbol names when the meaning search cannot answer (no daemon, no embedding model on disk). Off by default. On `eval/brief-gate/` with a daemon but no model, 35 of 63 English prompts name an expected file in the first eight paths instead of 27, and 10 of 22 French instead of 3; no gate decision moves.
